INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES – January 27, 2021

The Inglewood Library Board met on January 27, 2021 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 6:37 p.m. by
Board Member Pat Douglas.

Roll Call

Present:
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Public Comments

  None

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh asked the board to discuss the current date and time of the
scheduled library board meeting of the 4th Wednesday of the month at 6:30 pm. He wanted to reiterate that staff are
willing and able to accommodate any date and times necessary at the pleasure of the board.
  Board members decided to change the time of the meetings from 6:30pm to 5:00pm of every 4th
Wednesday of the month.

Library Report

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh gave the board members update of the Library -

    The implementation of the library’s new Sirsi system that will go live on February 4

    Purchases mainly consist of eBooks. The library will start ordering more physical books after going live with
  the new system

    The new furniture that we received for the first floor of the Main Library

    Working with design groups on creating a New library logo

    Working on updating library webpage, adding a new section to make suggestions for purchases
  1
     Library being Fine Free

    Library adding a podcast

    Staff will continue working from home all month of February, which means we are not going to have
  curbside services and are going to have only electronic resources
Public Comments

  None

Friends Report

  Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library (FOIPL) informed the board that thanks
to Mr. Singh the FOIPL is in the Library’s monthly newsletter with Community Connections item. Hopefully we will
be able to put something into the newsletter periodically so people will know what’s going on in our community to
support our library. FOIPL is also on Amazon Smile as a charity that people can connect to. So, when you shop on
Amazon, sign up and designate FOIPL as your preferred charity, any purchase that is eligible, 0.5% of the amount
goes to Friends of Inglewood Public Library. Also, looking forward to accepting donations and hopefully have a
book sale by the end of the summer.

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh added that Amazon smile will also be on the monthly
newsletter and he’ll work with the city council members to make sure to share the link with everyone in the city who
purchases from Amazon will consider using the link for Amazon smile.

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  All Board members thanked Mr. Singh for all the dedication and keeping everything moving and very happy
for so many great things happening.

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh thanked everyone.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 7:26 p.m.
